places.name: The Lens-Houses
places.epithet: The most delicate work in the Weave
places.text: Where lenses are ground in air so still that not a mote of dust settles crooked.

places.name: The Calibration Hall
places.text: Where wind-instruments from all over Skyloom are brought to be set against air that does not move.

places.name: The Anchor-Ring Foundry
places.text: Where the bronze anchor-rings that hold the Loom to the Skyward Towers are cast.

places.name: The Firing Range
places.text: A long cleared strip along the mere's shore, where artillery is test-fired and the fall of every shot measured with no wind to blame.

places.name: The Loomwardens' Post
places.text: Where the Loomwardens who hold Stillmere's air perfectly still keep watch. The silence unsettles visitors; the locals no longer hear it.

places.name: Quiet Square
places.text: The market square, where hawkers do not shout because the still air carries a whisper across it.

places.name: The Stillmerean Trail
places.text: One of the trails stitching together Skyloom's southern lake-towns.
